# v0.28.0 — First Completable Release

**Client v0.75.4 / APWorld v0.28.0 · Updated September 18, 2026**

This is the first release with the intended AP Star goal and an in-game final-boss victory condition implemented. It includes everything developed since v0.26.0-dev, including the previously unpublished v0.27 check expansion. It remains experimental: automated generation and client tests pass, but a complete clean-save native playthrough of the new Star/victory system has not yet been completed.

## September 18 hotfix — Client v0.75.4

- Fixed the unsafe Star Eater reference assignment that caused crashes entering Roots or interacting with its Star Eater. Uses the native object-reference setter, verifies the assignment, and rolls back a failed write.
- Fixed repeated cassette-save metadata scans and reduced unnecessary scene searches, inventory copying and empty notification work. Live song testing showed cassette reconciliation falling from about 9.7 ms to 0.007 ms per frame. Players report a substantial improvement; occasional note-affecting hitches remain under investigation.
- Level 22 completion now requires Plant Pipes in generator logic. Its star checks, cassette source, King Ferdinand/keycard rewards and Victory inherit that requirement. Luck-dependent no-pipes clears are not assumed.
- Optional performance diagnostics are disabled by default. If enabled during troubleshooting, set `Developer.EnablePerformanceDiagnostics=false` and restart for ordinary play.

**Hotfix verification:** 140 APWorld tests, 34 client regression projects, and 12 real generation/playthrough cases across all difficulties and Star goals 1/40/66 pass.

**Hotfix source:** [v0.28.0-hotfix.1](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/tree/v0.28.0-hotfix.1). The original `v0.28.0` tag and GitHub automatic source archives remain the original release; use the hotfix source tag to build the updated downloads.

**Updating:** replace the client DLLs with the v0.75.4 archive. Existing saves and seeds remain compatible with the client fixes. Install the updated `scrc.apworld` before generating a new seed to get the Plant Pipes rule. Updating files does not rewrite existing seed placements; some older seeds rely on the previous no-pipes boss route and would require a new seed or an explicitly agreed recovery to adopt the stricter rule.

**Still experimental:** the full clean-save victory playthrough is unfinished. The Quicksand/Music Lab chest vanilla-cassette leak and occasional gameplay hitches remain open; see [known issues](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).

## AP Stars and victory

- All 66 individual AP Stars are active. Set `required_stars` from 1 to 66; the default is 50.
- Received AP Stars govern generated normal campaign entry requirements. The first two levels require zero; later requirements increase and cap at half the victory goal to keep progression moving. Every entry requirement stays below the goal, including Level 22.
- Win by successfully clearing normal Level 22 after reaching your Star goal. Clearing it early and receiving the last Star afterward does not grant victory; you must replay and clear it.
- Star counting rebuilds from authoritative item history, retains synchronized totals during temporary disconnects, and avoids duplicate counts on replay. Completed victory delivery can recover after reconnect/restart.
- The five Star Eaters use the new seed's transmitted AP Star thresholds. Stars are checked, not consumed. Old Royal/Bunker testing overrides do not bypass the new contract.
- The client exposes AP Star totals and level-preview requirements without overwriting native performance ratings. Earned level ratings still send the appropriate performance checks; they only increase AP Stars when a randomized reward is a Star.
- Music Lab Points remain separate: 20 items worth 180 points, with the same nine chest thresholds.

## 39 new checks since v0.26

Quest checks observe actual native sources. Ordinary quest rewards remain native unless an existing randomized item system replaces them. King Ferdinand's unlock now sends a check; King ownership itself is not a new randomized AP item.

- Roots - Combo Bucket Conversion
- Lobby - Important Letters Delivery
- Lobby - Plunger Hand-In
- Lobby - Star Eater Fed
- Lobby - Fish Tears Delivery
- Meat Dimension - Act 1 Music Delivery
- Meat Dimension - Act 2 Music Delivery
- Meat Dimension - Act 3 Music Delivery
- Meat Dimension - Act 4 Music Delivery
- Meat Dimension - Return Cat
- Meat Dimension - Return Scruffy
- Meat Dimension - Mouse Revolution
- Cell Tower - Deliver Super Nectar
- Tower of Fear - Restore Eye Statue
- Tower of Fear - Restore Mind Statue
- Tower of Fear - Restore Heart Statue
- Royal Corridor - Star Eater Fed
- Lobby - Important Letters Pickup
- Lobby - Demolition Certificate Award
- Meat Dimension - Wooden Spoon Pickup
- Meat Dimension - Saw Disc Pickup
- Meat Dimension - Frying Pan Pickup
- Meat Dimension - Fish Tears Award
- Cell Tower - Meet the Bees
- Tower of Fear - Eye Pickup
- Tower of Fear - Mind Pickup
- Tower of Fear - Heart Pickup
- Royal Corridor - Bunker Keycard Award
- Lobby - Use Bunker Keycard
- Secret Bunker - Gecko Interaction
- Secret Bunker - Star Eater Fed
- Nectar Party - Completion
- Act 1B: Nectar - Completion
- Demonic Room - Completion
- Demonic Tower - Completion
- Demonic Escape - Completion
- Demonic Lockers - Completion
- Cell Tower - Star Eater Fed
- Royal Corridor - King Ferdinand Unlocked

The two Bee and four Devil completions are binary completion checks; they do not create normal campaign Star-tier checks. Shared conversations and rewards are not counted again as invented extra locations.

Total addressed checks: **Normal 164 / Hard 222 / Expert 280 / Perfection 316** (previously 125 / 183 / 241 / 277).

## Fixes and progression improvements

- Fixed native Meoo/Maniac unlock sequences bypassing randomized character ownership. Hand-ins can send their checks while the characters wait for their AP items.
- Fixed delayed Hip Glasses and Chicken Bucket delivery on newly bound saves, with bounded retry and save-identity isolation. Consumed items remain consumed instead of being restored by received-history replay.
- Fixed the glowing but non-interactable Music Lab 20-point chest path by routing the native interaction through the existing AP point rule.
- Added source journals and result recovery for the expanded checks, with source-versus-ownership separation, duplicate suppression and AP/native-save isolation.
- Modeled campaign, cassette and quest prerequisites to fit the 66 Stars without reducing existing item quantities or adding artificial cache checks. Normal has 152 modeled eligible locations for 137 non-filler items.
- Corrected the Tower statue rules to require both the statue's own branch clearance and the part from another branch, including the relevant ability. Corrected Combo Bucket conversion to include its Level 5 gate.

Close the game and replace the three plugin DLLs using **RhythmCastleAP-v0.75.13.zip**.

See [known issues](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).
The project remains experimental despite the verified end-to-end victory.

Investigate movement and frame pacing, verify delayed cassette delivery, and expand
seed/difficulty/multiworld coverage. No additional boss replay is needed for the
accepted victory fix.

All 35 client regression projects and 141 APWorld tests passed for this release.
Repository contract validation and diff checks passed. The client Release build
completed with zero errors; NuGet vulnerability-feed lookup was unavailable.
An independent code review found no critical/important new regression. The packaged
DLL matches the installed v0.75.13 build. Hard40 Victory is live-confirmed; the Tower
exterior test was explicitly deferred. Existing 12-case generation evidence is
historical; no new progression rules or IDs changed in this maintenance release.

# v0.29.0 — Cassette Bundles, Movement and Access Rules

**APWorld 0.29.0 / Client 0.76.0**

October 12, 2026 release.

## Added

- Optional randomized cassette bundles: `individual` (default), `pairs`, or `triples`. Each seed chooses its own groups, preserved across reconnects and Universal Tracker reconstruction. All cassette source and medal checks remain available.
- Bundle notifications and recent-item history identify the component songs.

## Fixed and improved

- Corrected Montage animal update timing without forcing a 50 FPS cap. The user accepted the improvement at normal high frame rates.
- Made the Regular/Pro Change selector usable before completing Level 1, including the initial save-to-hub transition.
- Improved item delivery readiness, deferred retries and native inventory verification so receipts can arrive without restarting. Pair-bundle receipt, deposit, immediate song selection and persistence after restart were verified in gameplay.
- Corrected Roots phone-booth presentation so the early portal does not obscure the Gecko and Weed Killer interactions.
- Allowed Music Lab reward chests to be opened when their vanilla cartridge reward is already owned. The Bloody Tears chest was verified while carrying Bloody Tears.
- Added a Star check before native level-entry side effects to prevent a failed entry from leaving the entrance unavailable until an area reload. This specific recovery case still needs live acceptance.
- Removed obsolete movement experiments and the temporary F9 frame-rate test; retained F8 movement capture. Display mode and frame-rate preferences remain native, with no forced fullscreen or frame cap.
- Repaired generation capacity for excluded checks by consolidating Music Lab point denominations when needed, preserving all 180 points, 66 Stars and other items.

## Access rules and Universal Tracker

- Lobby Access independently opens Boring Room, Minim Tower and The Vault, retaining each level's own Star gate.
- Plunger use requires Lobby Access and Plunger; Lobby Star Eater additionally requires its configured Star threshold.
- Corrected direct access to the Plunger, Bees, Frying Pan and Smooch pickups.
- Bucket Minion trade requires Roots Access and Hip Glasses without unrelated campaign completion.
- Corrected the Demolition Certificate source to use Boring Room rather than Demolition Training.
- Removed Central Mainframe from bee-variant access requirements while retaining each ordinary base route, Cell Tower Access and Hypno Pan.
- Added the Cell Tower return route for Fish Tears delivery while retaining the native Act 4 award requirement.
- Added the Lobby return entrance to Lift Quest and its cassette sources, preserving Roots Access and the level's own Star gate. Combo Bucket conversion still requires its inputs.
- Corrected Royal Corridor Star Eater access to area access plus its configured Star threshold.
- Required Plant Pipes for Level 15, Level 16's higher ratings and explicitly for Cold Storage. Level 22 retains Plant Pipes as a required logical route.
- Loneliness and Party Non Stop retain Hypno Pan.
- Improved tracker slot-data validation and cassette-route handling; expanded the prerequisite audit so inherited requirements are visible.

## Compatibility and installation

- Archipelago 0.6.8 generation and Universal Tracker 0.2.32 were tested.
- Install `scrc.apworld` in the Archipelago installation used by the generator and Universal Tracker, then restart those programs.
- Install the client ZIP following the setup guide before playing a bundled seed. Individual-cassette seeds retain schema 19; bundled seeds use schema 20 and require Client 0.76.0.
- Existing seeds retain their item placements, bundle mappings and Star gates. Updated logic does not regenerate an existing seed or guarantee that older placements satisfy newly tightened requirements.
- Follow the normal Universal Tracker setup, including its player YAML requirements where applicable; this release does not claim that YAML files are unnecessary.
- Packaging retains third-party license notices and excludes game assemblies and local logs. Original project code is MIT licensed.

## Validation

- 190 APWorld tests passed.
- 54 official AP 0.6.8 generation cases passed across difficulties, Star goals, cassette modes, exclusions and mixed-game sessions, with independent collection through Victory.
- Universal Tracker matched the world rules in 12 worlds and 1,888 inventory states.
- The client regression suite contains 42 projects; the release build is verified without installing over the running game.
- Both distributable archives passed the release packager's validation.

Automated consistency checks do not establish every native route; gameplay acceptance and remaining limitations are listed separately.

## Known issues and deferred testing

- Cold Storage and Cell Tower Star Eater story prerequisites need further investigation; deferred at the user's request.
- School Trip's Plant Pipes requirements and the Gold/On the Way cassette alternatives remain under review.
- Higher King Ferdinand ratings depend on late-game Gecko content that is not fully modeled. Those checks remain filler-only and are not guaranteed reachable.
- Bunker Keycard, Notepad, Data Stick and Demon Key work remains outside the completed AP-item/check scope; conservative Bunker/Demonic assumptions remain.
- Native Hypno Pan crafting alternatives are not comprehensively represented in item logic.
- Intermittent song/windowed/Combo Bucket performance and movement outside the accepted Montage case may still occur.
- Triple bundles, other delayed-item scenarios, Star-blocked entrance recovery, and the newer Lobby callback readiness paths need further live coverage.
- The revised tracker passed offline engine comparisons; a fresh live UI comparison remains useful.

## Development disclosure

This implementation uses substantial AI assistance. See the [AI disclosure](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.0/docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md) for tools, scope, the owner's design and gameplay-testing role, and the limits of human source review. The disclosure should accompany the release announcement and be pinned in the project channel.

## Next

Gather feedback on the updated release and prioritize remaining performance, delivery and native-route reports. Cold Storage/Cell Tower Star Eater testing remains deferred.

# v0.29.1 — Player movement repair

**October 12, 2026. Client 0.76.1 / APWorld 0.29.0 (unchanged).**

## Fixed

- Fixed the captured player-movement stalls where animation stayed smooth but movement repeatedly slowed or stopped, including after songs and area transitions. Very short input-movement updates now accumulate their elapsed time before being applied, avoiding the observed acceleration resets.
- Kept native rendering and frame-rate preferences; this repair does not force fullscreen or a 50 FPS cap.

## Diagnostics and documentation

- Expanded opt-in F8 movement captures with bounded player-update timing records, movement speed values and repair counters. Detailed recording is active only during a capture.
- Reorganized the README and current documentation, removed contradictory setup/version guidance, and archived superseded plans and test checkpoints with an index.
- Updated the current issue list and recorded the newly completed gameplay acceptance tests.

## Updating

Close the game and replace the client files with **RhythmCastleAP-v0.76.1.zip**, retaining the included licenses. Keep your configuration, current seed and associated save. The APWorld remains **0.29.0**; its logic, IDs, options, item placements, bundle mappings and Star gates are unchanged. An APWorld download is included for convenience, not as a required upgrade from 0.29.0.

## Validation

The movement implementation was accepted in gameplay before its version-only release bump: initial movement, after a Music Lab song, room changes, restart, Hypno Pan NPC movement, stopping, reversing, gentle analogue input, solid-wall collision and pause/resume. Diagnostic samples confirmed the repair active.

Automated coverage includes player timing boundaries, one normal and three faulty recorded timing streams, the timing recorder, movement capture, Montage timing, notification bursts and cassette bundles. All 44 client regression projects passed for publication. The Release build, repository validator, 10 packaging tests and final archive checks passed. NuGet vulnerability metadata could not be fetched; this is not a completed dependency-security audit. Managed tests do not prove every native configuration.

Additional tests confirmed Star-blocked entrance retry without area reload; immediate item receipt/deposit and persistence; original Plant Pipes/Hip Glasses pickups; Meoo/Plunger/Star Eater checks; Superstar insertion and medal preview; and Quicksand/Bloody Tears chests without duplicate vanilla rewards. These validate existing behavior rather than introduce new features in this patch.

## Known limits

Intermittent note-affecting performance stalls remain under investigation; the movement repair is not a claim that all frame hitches are fixed. Extended-session and multiplayer movement coverage remains incomplete. Triple cassette bundles and large notification batches have automated coverage but less native acceptance than the tested paths. Native route/modeling uncertainties remain listed in [known issues](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.1/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).
